verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. Adjacent items such as the GitHub compliance-skills agent skills, llms.txt and webhooks are not an MCP server agents can connect to, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
